blocks.text: Queues graphs mein breadth-first search, task scheduling, print spooling aur call centre systems mein istemal hoti hain.

blocks.prompt: Call centre intezar karne walon ke liye queue kyun istemal karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke callers ko usi tarteeb se jawab mile jis mein unhon ne call ki: first in, first out.

items: Queue ke istemal: BFS, task scheduling, print spooling, call centres, buffering.
